summary: 30-foot pole L-4 tower on Bobtail Peak in Coeur d'Alene National Forest, built 1934 and destroyed 1955; overgrown site with cement footings.

facts.design: 30-foot pole L-4 tower with L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1955; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the site gone

staffing.status: one documented staff member, Charles Huelleman, 1934

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as drive-up. A 2022 post describes it as completely overgrown; no source describes the land's access rules

notes_for_editor: Brief event '1955 destroyed' confirmed by all four pages; the brief lacked the 1934 build date, now added. Brief county 'Shoshone' matches the FFLA page ('Shoshone County, Idaho'). Staffing rests on one name from the Idaho Fire Lookouts page, which cites a 1934 Wallace Press-Times item; the newspaper itself was not read. Site today: described only in the Idaho Fire Lookouts post (posted July 4, 2022); no source gives the land's access rules. Height: 30 ft converted to 9.1 m. Weebly index lists the township 50N-5E-6, not used in the record.
